meta.description: Machine-readable design system for Studio Harmon — 'Forge' aesthetic (dark, industrial, for the trades). CSS variables live on :root in src/styles/global.css — reference the token, never the raw hex. Legacy names (--paper, --white, --clay) remain as aliases pointing at the Forge tokens.

--ember.role: Accent base (LOCKED yellow-gold) — CTAs, logo, markers, glow

--on-accent.role: Text/icon color on an accent fill

aliases.note: Legacy names kept so existing var() references keep resolving.

labelVoice.note: Mono uppercase for eyebrows, nav links, tags, badges, step numbers, footer headings, footer meta, form labels, metric labels.

capitalization.h3: UPPERCASE (card titles, feature titles, step titles)

accentHighlight.note: Wrap one or two words in <em> with .mark-clay (font-style:normal; color:var(--ember))

texture.heroBlueprint: Layered grid via .hero::before — bold lines every 100px at rgba(238,240,242,.10), fine lines every 25px at rgba(238,240,242,.04); masked to fade out toward the bottom (88%).

motion.note: Restrained only. One subtle marquee on the home services bar. No looping/decorative animation.

btn-ink.role: Primary CTA (maps to the same ember fill as btn-clay)

buttons.base: inline-flex; gap:9px; font-weight:600; font-size:15px; padding:14px 24px; radius:4px; uppercase; letter-spacing:.04em; optional trailing .arr

principles: One ember accent — no second hue, no gradients beyond the hero/CTA glow.
Accent used sparingly: CTAs, logo mark, square markers, key highlights.
Spec-sheet voice: uppercase display headings paired with a monospace label voice.
Hairline borders, small radii, blueprint grid texture in the hero.
Restrained, fast motion only. Masculine and modern, not loud.

componentPatterns.hero: Eyebrow + clamp UPPERCASE display H1 with ember-marked words + sub paragraph + CTA row, over a blueprint grid + warm glow, followed by full-bleed marquee. Ref: index.astro
componentPatterns.work-grid: 2-col grid of dark cards (--card, 1px --line, 6px radius): image + body row (uppercase name, mono tag). Hover lifts + ember border. Ref: index.astro #work
componentPatterns.dark-panel: Card panel (radius 6px) with ember eyebrow + H2 + numbered steps with ember numerals + mono tag pills. Ref: index.astro #how
componentPatterns.services-list: Bordered rows grid 46px/1.1fr/1.4fr/auto: mono ember index, uppercase title, description, ember icon. Rows indent + go --bg-2 on hover. Ref: index.astro #services
componentPatterns.metrics: Three --card panels with large light Archivo number + mono label. Ref: index.astro metrics
componentPatterns.pricing: Two-column grid; featured card gets --line-2 outline + 3px ember top bar. Square ember list markers. Ref: index.astro #pricing
componentPatterns.cta-banner: --card panel, --line-2 outline, 8px radius, centered H2 + button row, bottom radial ember glow. Ref: index.astro CTA
componentPatterns.split-form: 0.85fr/1.15fr two-column: left lede + steps/facts, right --card panel with mono labels + dark inputs. Collapses at 900px. Ref: start.astro, book.astro
